items.a: **Named artifact + check command**; review ends verified+fingerprint or missing+reason; **dispatcher re-runs the check**.

items.q: How does Level 2 catch fact errors?
items.a: **Two agents extract independently**; a third reconciles differences **only against the original source**.
**High-stakes reasoning** (legal, PR claims): self-audit, cold adversarial reviewers, then fresh final reviewers.
